# Data model (rendered from source)

The validator stores two kinds of thing: SQL tables it can read (public rows: rep events, stakes, zk registrations and eligibility, attestations, anonymous casts) and state namespaces the app persists through it. A namespace is either PLAIN (the validator can read the JSON) or SEALED (one AES-256-GCM record per namespace, padded to a KiB step, whose key never leaves the device). Which is which is decided in one place, `lib/vault/vault.ts`; this page renders that decision.

## Deliberately absent

Things the validator has NO column, row or namespace for, on purpose. Each one is a link an operator could otherwise make; the linkage tests (v1–v5) assert their absence on every sweep.

- a persona → root map (removed in ZK pass 2, migration 006; the validator learns which personas exist, not whose they are)
- a root balance of influence allowance (the vault holds it; the validator sees per-persona stake rows only)
- a scroll-zone layout, a button binding, a search query or a search index (device-local; the index is re-derived from the vault)
- a DM's text, tweet id or sender beyond the persona's own attested handle (the bookmark is an opaque hash; the item is sealed)
- a relationship-port record or a pending grant in plaintext (sealed)
- a custody address, signer key, registrant or funder for any persona account (the fid map is sealed; the plain map holds fid + fname)
- a private post's text (sealed), or any row that names two personas of one root together
